title: The Planets - Mars, the Bringer of War (opening)
video_use_ideas: Ominous 5/4 build-up for a conflict, a showdown or a storm.
legal_notes: FLAG HOLST: d.1934 -> PD in life+70 countries (EU/UK) since 2005; The Planets published 1921 -> PD in US.
